criterion_fired: Criterion 4 (Actionable next steps) and Criterion 2 (Carry-forward consistency)
suggested_change: Criterion 4 should explicitly require: 'All next steps must include specific, measurable ask (e.g., exact dates, dollar amounts, counts, or defined approval roles). Prohibit: walk me through, help me understand, tell me about. Replace with: Confirm [specific metric/date/decision-maker].' Criterion 2 should require: 'If score unchanged, explicitly state why new information did not justify upgrade. If score upgraded, identify which unknown element became known.'
